name: Expert Memory
description: Builds three-layer ExpertAgent memory with summary index, skill cards, task summaries, and supporting evidence.

capabilities.name: expert-memory
capabilities.description: Exposes summary.md, skills, task summaries, and evidence files through the Agent context system.

capabilities.name: memory-pipeline
capabilities.description: Builds task summaries, session summaries, skill cards, and summary.md from runtime evidence.

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: Enables or disables all Expert Memory plugin behavior.

properties.name: useMemories
properties.description: Exposes accepted memory context to the Agent when memory files exist.

properties.name: generateMemories
properties.description: Generates task summaries, session summaries, and skill cards from captured evidence.

properties.name: disableOnExternalContext
properties.description: Skips memory generation when task context marks externalContext=true.

properties.name: minRunOutputChars
properties.description: Minimum run output length before a successful run stores reusable lessons.

properties.name: summaryMaxBytes
properties.description: Maximum summary.md size read into Agent context.

properties.name: maxOutputExcerptChars
properties.description: Maximum number of characters persisted from final output or error text.

properties.name: maxToolExcerptChars
properties.description: Maximum number of characters persisted from tool output or tool errors.

properties.name: taskSummaryModel
properties.description: Optional future model selector for task summary generation.

properties.name: sessionSummaryModel
properties.description: Optional future model selector for session summary generation.

properties.name: skillMergeModel
properties.description: Optional future model selector for skill card merging.

properties.name: summaryModel
properties.description: Optional future model selector for summary.md generation.

properties.name: memoryRoot
properties.description: Workspace-relative directory used to store summary, skills, task summaries, and evidence.
